vocabulary.meaning_en: a hot brown drink made from roasted beans
vocabulary.example: I drink a coffee every morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: coffee made with espresso and hot milk with foam on top
not big and not small; the middle size
how big or small something is
a kind or sort of something
vocabulary.example: What type of coffee do you like?

vocabulary.meaning_en: small pieces of chocolate inside a cake or cookie
vocabulary.example: I like cookies with chocolate chips.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money in coins and paper notes
a bank card you use to pay
a paper that shows what you bought and paid
the food or drinks you ask for in a shop or café

vocabulary.example: Your coffee will be ready soon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a strong way to say yes
used to add or change something you said
vocabulary.example: Actually, can I also have some water?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take away and eat or drink outside the shop
vocabulary.note_ar: في بريطانيا يقولون أيضًا: to take away

vocabulary.meaning_en: to eat or drink inside the shop
vocabulary.example: Is it for here or to go?

fine_lines.title: for here vs to go
fine_lines.explanation_ar: for here: تشرب أو تأكل داخل المقهى. to go: تأخذ الطلب معك إلى الخارج.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "For here" means you stay in the café. "To go" means you take it with you.

examples.sentence: I'll have it for here, please.

fine_lines.title: cash vs card
fine_lines.explanation_ar: cash هو المال الورقي والمعدني، وcard هي البطاقة البنكية. نقول: pay in cash و pay by card / with card.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Cash is coins and notes. A card is a bank card. We say "pay in cash" and "pay by card" or "pay with card".

expressions.phrase: Can I get a coffee, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على قهوة من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to ask for something in a shop.
expressions.example: Can I get a tea, please?

expressions.phrase: What type of coffee would you like?
expressions.meaning_en: The worker asks which kind of coffee you want.
expressions.example: What type of tea would you like?
I'll have an orange juice, please.

expressions.meaning_en: An informal way to say "yes, of course".

expressions.phrase: Would you like it for here or to go?
expressions.meaning_en: The worker asks if you will stay or take it out.
expressions.example: Would you like your sandwich for here or to go?

expressions.meaning_en: The worker asks if you want more.
The worker tells you the price.
expressions.example: That will be five dollars, please.

expressions.meaning_en: The worker asks how you will pay.

expressions.phrase: Your order will be ready in just a few minutes.
expressions.meaning_ar: سيكون طلبك جاهزًا خلال دقائق قليلة.
expressions.meaning_en: The worker tells you to wait a little.
expressions.example: Your food will be ready in a few minutes.

grammar.title: Ordering politely: I'll have / Can I get
grammar.explanation_ar: للطلب بأدب نستخدم: I'll have + الشيء + please، أو Can I get + الشيء + please? كلمة please تجعل الطلب مهذبًا.
grammar.explanation_en: To order politely, say "I'll have ... , please" or "Can I get ... , please?". "Please" makes it polite.
examples: Can I get a muffin, please?
Can I also get a water, please?

grammar.title: Would you like ...?
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم Would you like لنعرض شيئًا أو نسأل عن رغبة شخص بأدب. بعدها اسم أو to + فعل.
grammar.explanation_en: We use "Would you like ...?" to offer something or ask what someone wants, politely.
examples: Would you like it hot or iced?
Would you like to sit here?

questions.question: What does "to go" mean in a coffee shop?
choices: to drink it in the shop
questions.explanation_ar: to go تعني أن تأخذ الطلب معك إلى الخارج.
questions.explanation_en: "To go" means you take your order out of the shop.

questions.question: Choose the polite order:
questions.explanation_ar: I'll have ... please هي الطريقة المهذبة للطلب.

questions.question: "Cash or card?" The worker wants to know ...
questions.explanation_en: The question is about how you will pay.

questions.question: Small, ____, or large?
questions.explanation_en: The sizes are small, medium and large.

questions.question: What is a "receipt"?
choices: a paper that shows what you paid
questions.explanation_ar: receipt هو الإيصال الذي يبين ما دفعته.
questions.explanation_en: A receipt is a paper that shows what you bought and paid.

questions.question: ____ you like it for here or to go?
questions.explanation_ar: نقول Would you like للعرض المهذب.
questions.explanation_en: We say "Would you like ...?" to ask politely.

questions.question: "Actually, can I also get a muffin?" Here "actually" is used to ...
questions.explanation_ar: actually هنا لإضافة شيء جديد إلى الطلب.
questions.explanation_en: Here "actually" adds something new to the order.

questions.question: Which letter is silent in "receipt"?
questions.explanation_ar: حرف p في receipt لا يُنطق.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation_ar: نقول pay with card أو pay by card.
questions.explanation_en: We say "pay with card" or "pay by card".
